description: D11: a listed session the agent could not read counts as covered when the manifest's errors[] names it. A transcript the manifest itself could not read blocks the stamp in each form (Claude `unreadable <path>`, Kiro `(not read)`), also for a `Tasks 4-5 only` project (FIX-STATE-tasks45-unread-session); an unreadable plan or memory file is not a session and does not block.

reasons: the manifest could not read 1 transcript(s) or session(s)
